author: k. b. goebel
title: Cal Poly women's golf finishes 16th at Huntington Bank Collegiate in Texas
text:
Cal Poly Women’s Golf finished its regular season on Apr. 7 by placing 16th out of 17 teams at the Huntington Bank Collegiate in Westlake, Texas.
The Mustangs ended the three-round event with a team total of 904, or 40 over par. The field included several nationally-ranked programs, and No. 27 Oklahoma State won the tournament with a score of 25 under par.
Sophomore Nicole Koong led Cal Poly individually, tying for 50th place after posting rounds of 73, 77, and a final round of even-par-72 for a total score of six over par (222). Sara Torres tied for 56th at seven over par (223), highlighted by her second-round score of one under par (71).
Other scorers for Cal Poly included Sarah Yoo, who tied for 78th at fourteen over par (230) after rounds of 75, 80, and another round of 75. Maddy Saysanasongkham and Alex Flier both finished tied for 83rd place at nineteen over par; Saysanasongkham recorded scores of 77, 80, and then improved to a final round of seventy-eight while Flier shot rounds of eighty-three followed by back-to-back seventy-sixes.
With the regular season complete, Cal Poly will have nearly two weeks off before competing in the Big West Women’s Golf Championship scheduled from April nineteenth to twenty-first at Kaanapali Resort in Maui.
